'''Sweet berry mash''' is the simple preparation of [[Sweet Berries|sweet berries]]. It heals {{Hp|2}} and grants {{EffectLink|Health Boost}} for 10 seconds.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/sweet_berry_mash.json}}</ref>

== Obtaining ==

=== Cooking ===
{{Recipes}}
Sweet berries cook into sweet berry mash in an [[oven]] or on [[kindling]] in 5 seconds. Picking up sweet berries unlocks the oven recipe.

== Usage ==

=== Food ===
Eating sweet berry mash takes 0.8 seconds, heals {{Hp|2}} and gives Health Boost I (+2 hearts of maximum health) for 0:10.

Obtaining sweet berry mash unlocks [[Sweet Berry Jam|sweet berry jam]] and the [[Sweet Berry Danish|sweet berry Danish]].

=== Crafting ingredient ===
{{Uses}}

== Advancements ==
* ''Powerful Flavors'': cook an intrinsic ingredient. Obtaining any of the 11 simple preparations of the ordinary intrinsic ingredients completes it.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/advancement/tutorial/cook_food.json}}</ref>
